notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.931 - Production Release Candidate
notes.content:
We're hoping to come out of Early Access this week and this is our first release candidate.

A big fix this week was when the skater would bail in between rooftops in Endless or Career, and the ragdoll would pass through a "failsafe trigger" and immediately force the user to the End of Run screen without giving them time to decide if they wanted to continue that run or not.

3-12's Blimps no longer pass through buildings and we've added some ambient blimps to all the background rooftop career levels.

[list]
[*] New: Freeze camera on ragdoll hit failsafe instead of skip to end of ragdoll timer
[*] Fixed sound override trigger on some buildings
[*] Moving blimps added to rooftops career levels
[*] Tweaked some air vehicle placements in 3-12
[*] Drop down menu fixes & tighter epic mode cam vertical follow
[*] Fixed floating QP's and added a missing checkpoint to 3-6
[*] Fix records menu skater anim
[/list]

Please let us know if you are having any issues as we would like to launch out of Early Access as early as the next few days.

Thanks!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/9c77e0fc65d24ef30ba20b1fb8b135b64c36819c.png[/img]

The game should detect what type of gamepad you are using and remap those button prompt images to the correlating gamepad.  

If this is not happening for you, please let us know what kind of controller you are using.  You can also switch what type of controller you are using to see the correct prompts in the settings menu.

notes.title: Endless mode overhaul! - Patch notes for 0.914
notes.content:
Now when you complete a goal in endless mode, it is instantly replaced with a new goal!

You can press R3 to get your rewards, or wait until you end the run. 

This prevents the user from having to stop the flow of an Endless run in order to get new goals to be completed.  

[list]
[*] Added new sponsor to the game: Plain Skateboards
[*] Overhauling endless goals to auto regen.  Now you can keep racking up goals without ending your run to get new ones
[*] Removed use drink, find coins, buy goal, and use perk goal types from Endless
[*] Adding button prompts to UI for all header contexts
[*] Revisions to new Rooftops drops piece in Tier 1 Endless
[*] Added new skatespot to Rooftops in Tier 3 Endless
[*] Fix for some particles showing up as more white from a distance than intended
[*] Adjusted end of run banger slow motion bangers back to .1 instead of .5
[*] Added 4 selecteable cam angles for filmer mode, and set to be .5 slow motion
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback on the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/YAVRyXm]Epic Skater Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Epic Skater 2 is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/f59a3c6ac8724c46b7e36df1c315c7d5deaf8f36.png[/img]

Hi all, and welcome to Early Access!

Please join the discussion on Discord: http://discord.gg/YAVRyXm

Thanks for following, adding to wishlist, and/or purchasing!  

We'll be updating regularly throughout Early Access.  Here's the low down of our game plan and what you'll be seeing and participating in the development of.

[b]High Level Goals:[/b]
[list]
[*] We want to make Epic Skater 2 into a premium experience.
[*] We're removing all of the mobile free-to-play nonsense.
[*] No Microtransactions. No IAP. No video ads.  No needless grinding (pun intended).
[*] We're in the middle of adding gamepad support and we appreciate your feedback
[*] We are planning on adding more Endless, Career, and Create a Skater content.
[/list]

[b]Where we're at:[/b]
The game currently includes 2 game modes (Career and Endless), over 600 Create a Skater items, over 40 upgrade-able tricks, over 30 Career levels, over 150 modular Endless pieces, full Keyboard and Mouse support, partial/experimental gamepad support for gameplay, a range of desktop resolutions in full screen and windowed, and a first iteration of progression and economy changes to support the removal of in-app purchasing and advertising.

We're looking forward to your feedback and we'll be updating a lot every week.  

If you'd like updates to what we're working on please follow Epic Skater 2 or the Epic Skater 2 steam group.
